verbs.name: assemble.broll
verbs.description: ASSEMBLY AUTOMATION — fill a list of b-roll SLOTS by retrieving a clip per slot and placing it on a b-roll track. For each `{query, at_ms, duration_ms}`: search the `provider` (default local_folder; any assets.* provider — openverse/archive_org/wikimedia/nasa for stock, or local_folder with `dir`) for `query`, FETCH the top hit as a project asset, and edit.insert its first `duration_ms` at `at_ms` (no ripple — the b-roll lands on its own track). ORCHESTRATOR (like audio.cleanup_voice / autopilot.run): records NO op of its own — it wraps the work in an auto-checkpoint and dispatches assets.search + assets.fetch + edit.insert as real, replay-safe ops, so the whole assembly reverts in ONE step. STOPS on the first failing slot and returns the checkpoint + a revert_hint (never a silently half-assembled timeline). `track` targets an existing track; omitted = a 'broll' video track (created if absent). `source:"generate"` is reserved for assets.generate. Requires an open project.

query.description: What this slot is about — the provider search query.

at_ms.description: Timeline position to place the retrieved clip.

duration_ms.description: How much of the retrieved source to place (its first duration_ms).

slots.description: The b-roll slots to fill, in any order.

source.description: search (default) = retrieve from a provider; generate = reserved for assets.generate.

provider.description: Which assets.* provider to search (default local_folder). e.g. local_folder, openverse, archive_org, wikimedia, nasa.

dir.description: Search dir for the local_folder provider.

track.description: Target track id (default: a 'broll' video track, created if absent).

verbs.result: {status, track, slots_filled, placed:[{slot,query,asset_id,clip_id,at_ms,duration_ms}], checkpoint, revert_hint} — or {status:"failed", slot, failed_step, error, placed, checkpoint, revert_hint} on the first failing slot. A delayed project-binding conflict also returns origin_checkpoint:{id,project:{project_identity,project_revision}} and recovery:{action:"reopen_origin_then_review_checkpoint",origin_project,checkpoint}; verify that origin identity, compare its current revision with the last accepted revision, and review intervening changes before restoring the origin checkpoint. No revert is directed at the now-current project. Orchestrator: no op of its own; the sub-verbs (assets.search/fetch, edit.insert) record the ops.
